mapper.select: SELECT id, office_user_id, office_username, deploy_user_id, deploy_login_id, deploy_name, active, linked_at, updated_at FROM deploy_sso_links WHERE office_user_id = #{officeUserId} AND active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deploy_sso_links(office_user_id, office_username, deploy_user_id, deploy_login_id, deploy_name, active, linked_at) VALUES(#{officeUserId}, #{officeUsername}, #{deployUserId}, #{deployLoginId}, #{deployName}, TRUE, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE office_username = VALUES(office_username), deploy_user_id = VALUES(deploy_user_id), deploy_login_id = VALUES(deploy_login_id), deploy_name = VALUES(deploy_name), active = TRUE, updated_at = NOW()
